type:
∀ {τ : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] {P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) K},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {n : ℕ},
      MvPolynomial.degreeOf none P ≤ n →
        ∃ (l : ℕ),
          1 ≤ l ∧
            l ≤ n + 1 ∧
              ∃ (φ : Fin l → Polynomial K) (ψ : Fin l → MvPolynomial τ K),
                LinearIndependent K φ ∧
                  LinearIndependent K ψ ∧
                    (∀ (ν : Fin l), (φ ν).natDegree ≤ n) ∧
                      (∀ (ν : Fin l) (j : τ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j (ψ ν) ≤ MvPolynomial.degreeOf (some j) P) ∧
                        P =
                          ∑ ν : Fin l, (Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X none)) (φ ν) * (MvPolynomial.rename some) (ψ ν)
what: Every nonzero polynomial in one distinguished and arbitrary remaining variables has a bounded separated decomposition with both factor families linearly independent.
how: Choose a finite basis of coefficient-polynomial span; build independent univariate coordinate polynomials; reconstruct by basis expansion and preserve support-box degrees.

mathlib_api_audit.conclusion: Complete mathlib-only unconditional PID proof, complete rational caller and conditional free-span proof verified; existing finite/free/tensor/rank primitives still require substantive coordinate/degree reconstruction.

moral_duplications: Two-factor tensor/matrix rank factorization is abstract mathematical context; generic pure-tensor expansion loses simultaneous independence and bounds.

generalization.to: CommRing K + IsDomain K + IsPrincipalIdealRing K
generalization.not_claimed: PID is not claimed the weakest possible scalar condition; given-basis variant is conditional.

missing_api: Bounded independent separated decomposition, using generic finite-free coefficient-span machinery.
junk: Not junk: substantive finite-rank decomposition, both independent factor families and degree control are used to construct nonzero Wronskians in the sole caller.
